But put your faith in Jesus Christ today.
Would you pray with me?
Heavenly Father, we confess that we are people that want to do something.
We want to do something to earn our acceptance with You, to commend ourselves to You.
It's at the very heart of what it means that we are in rebellion against You.
We don't want to depend upon You, and yet we thank You.
We thank you for what you have done and that in the good news of Jesus Christ we have encountered
a message not of what we need to do but of what you have already done and promised to
continue to do.
So Father we pray that you would work in us faith and love.
That you would give us ears to hear and understand this message and that you would cause this
message to grow and bear fruit in our lives, in our church, in our city, and indeed around
the world, to the glory of Jesus Christ, and we pray this in His name. Amen.
